selection_rationale: Poojith explicitly made S0 the submission gate, directed a warm S0 discriminator, then reduced the discriminator budget to 120 seconds so table screens can follow. This job is diagnostic only and cannot replace a full cold S0 replay.
trainium_feasibility: LNC2 x4 uses the full chip. Exact source SHA256 ad223cdc9aa339d820b8f66e32ad35e30d3e93437a79d263a1418f7e53e125bb already passed a four-rank CPU G2 for the bare 1800-second command; --max-train-seconds 120 is accepted by this file's parser at line 1250. The budget feeds Python-side LR, momentum and weight-decay schedules. Source inspection suggests model tensor shapes and compiled forward/backward graphs remain the same, but graph identity is a hypothesis to verify from native signatures, not a guaranteed property. The short budget may alter optimizer values and losses, so neither BPB nor training-loss comparison with 1800-second runs is meaningful. Compilation/startup can still take far longer than 120 seconds because the charged training clock excludes initial startup steps.
cheapest_falsifier: After exact-source/G2/host checks, capture the first Neuron compiler error or verify synchronized finite step boundaries through step 20 on all ranks. A repeat of the RNG/NEFF failure before step 1 rejects a clean-startup PASS; a successful start with no verified cache hit is S0-startup evidence but not warm-vs-cold causal proof.

cache_policy.proof_required: After A0 training/eval fully exit, authenticate populated paths and prelaunch object counts; record compiler effective cache path/hit or before-after artifacts. Existing objects alone do not prove a hit. Do not clear or overwrite any shared cache; no concurrent writer. Leave external NEURON_CC_FLAGS unset so the file's optlevel-1 default applies.

trusted_prepare.policy: Import unchanged trusted prepare.py from a pinned checkout via PYTHONPATH after verifying imported path and SHA; only train.py is copied to the new run sandbox.

evaluation: No public BPB evaluation is needed or valid for this 120-second compile smoke. Retrieve run log, per-rank step-boundary evidence, compiler/debug logs, startup allowance and charged training time, final checkpoint metadata/hash if produced, cache evidence and quiescent postflight. Any later full S0 run requires fresh public20M separately.

success_criteria.quality: Not measured; no public20M, no BPB delta, no decide.py win/adoption and no submission clearance.
success_criteria.throughput: Record startup/compile elapsed, startup allowance cap/excess, charged training time, effective cache evidence, all-rank step boundaries and graph signatures; do not compare step rate or losses with a full-budget control as a quality result.
success_criteria.correctness: Clean compile and runtime initialization on all four ranks, at least 20 completed finite synchronized training steps on each rank, normal termination and finite/loadable model checkpoint if the file writes one, no NaN/crash/over-budget, complete logs and quiescent postflight. If slow compilation consumes the startup allowance and the file cleanly ends before 20 steps, classify INCONCLUSIVE_FOR_CODE_CACHE rather than S0-defective. Fewer than 20 steps or missing per-rank proof is never a PASS; actual compiler errors are failures, and all evidence is retained.

abort_conditions: Any A0 train/eval or Neuron holder still active; disk free <6.5 GiB; STOP/breaker; missing or dirty source; unique label/root collision; incorrect cache path or unverified prepare import.
Any source-byte edit, compiler flag override, wrong argv/topology/seed, missing all-rank step evidence, NaN, crash, absent checkpoint or non-quiescent postflight.
Do not rerun a consumed label; archive the first real compiler error and rank journals on failure.
